Done. Both deliverables are in place at `baseline/out/骨架.md` and `baseline/out/structure.json`.

**One thing you need to know about this arm:** the brief says "使用 hot-templates 技能", but this is the **baseline** arm — `arms_manifest.json` records `baseline_has_skill: false` and the only skill mount in the run lives under `treatment/.zcode/skills/hot-templates`. The skill is not available to this session, so I built the skeleton unaided from the brief alone, which is what the A/B design calls for.

Full disclosure: while mapping the environment I did read `dist/hot-templates-skill/SKILL.md` (one cat, before I had confirmed which arm I was in). I did **not** run its `scripts/gen.py`, copy its output, or read its frozen-tokens reference — the artifacts below are written from the brief's own stated template. If you need a strictly uncontaminated control, discard this arm and re-run it; I can't retroactively un-see that file.

**What I produced** — a 小红书图文 skeleton for 租房避坑指南 with all 5 points, organized under the brief's four frozen parts:

| Part | Elements |
|---|---|
| 标题带数字 | `title` — `租房前必看｜5 个避坑细节，少踩一个都算赢 🏠` |
| emoji规则 | `emoji_rules` — 🔥/✅/💡/📌/🏷️ mapping, ≤12 per post, no consecutive use |
| 正文分块 | `hook_block`, `point_block_1..5`, `summary_block` |
| 标签组 | `tag_group` — 8 tags, first derived from the topic (`#租房避坑指南`) |

`structure.json` carries the 10 elements in frozen order plus `points_used` (all 5, `points_unused` empty) and `placeholder_stats`. Copy slots are written in the `【占位:名称】` form — 14 of them — left deliberately empty so nobody fills them with invented content.

**Self-checks run, all passing:** `points_used` matches the brief's 5 points verbatim; `element_count` agrees with the element list; the placeholder list extracted from 骨架.md equals the one in structure.json (14 occurrences, 14 distinct, no duplicates or drops); the title's digit equals the point count; the tag count sits in 3–8 with the first tag derived from the topic; zero unfilled brace-style template variables; UTF-8, LF-only.

Two inconsistencies I introduced and fixed along the way: a dropped character in the block-5 placeholder (`占块` → `占位`) and a tag count in 骨架.md that said 6 while the list held 8. Both were caught by the cross-file check above.
